entries.name: Citizen Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the classic Citizen backpack (Addon 1) and feather hat (Addon 2).
entries.lore: The Citizen outfit represents the hardworking people of Tibian towns. Carrying the sturdy leather backpack and donning the feathered hat proves your resourcefulness.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, traveler."
Player: "addon"
NPC: "Would you like to trade for the backpack addon?"
Player: "yes"
NPC: "Splendid! Bring me 100 Minotaur Leathers to complete it."

steps.title: Citizen Addon 1 (Backpack)
steps.instruction: Bring 100 Minotaur Leathers to Luboo at the church south of Thais.

steps.title: Citizen Addon 2 (Hat / Feather)
steps.instruction: Bring 100 Chicken Feathers, 50 Honeycombs and 1 Ape Fur to Hanna at the Thais jewelry shop.

entries.name: Hunter Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the Sniper Gloves (Addon 1) and Master Hunter Bow with Quiver (Addon 2).
entries.lore: Renowned archers of the Tibian wildlands wear this mastercrafted gear, designed for silent stalking and lethal accuracy.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, hunter."
Player: "addon"
NPC: "I can craft the famous sniper gloves if you have the materials."
Player: "yes"

steps.title: Hunter Addon 1 (Sniper Gloves)
steps.instruction: Visit Elane inside the Paladin Guild in Thais and deliver the Sniper Gloves.

entries.name: Knight Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the Steel Broadsword (Addon 1) and Horned Full Helmet (Addon 2).
entries.lore: The proud knights of the royal kingdom forge their equipment from royal steels and dragon hardened bones.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Hail, warrior!"
Player: "outfit"
NPC: "Are you worthy of the horned knight helm and royal sword?"
Player: "yes"

steps.title: Knight Addon 1 & 2
steps.instruction: Speak with Knight Guildmaster Gregor in southern Thais.

entries.name: Mage Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the Wand of Power (Addon 1) and the legendary Ferumbras' Hat (Addon 2).
entries.lore: The apex of magical prowess in Tibia. Wearing the hat torn from the head of the dark wizard Ferumbras marks you as a legend.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings in the light of the gods."
Player: "addon"
NPC: "To weave the ceremonial robes, we require dust from demons and vampires."
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: Mage Wand of Power & Ferumbras' Hat

steps.title: Mage Addon 1 (Cloak & Wand)
steps.instruction: Deliver the mystical cloths and dusts to Priestess Lynda in the Church of Thais.

steps.title: Mage Addon 2 (Ferumbras Hat)
steps.instruction: Bring the trophy Ferumbras Hat to Archmage Zoltan at the Edron Academy.

entries.name: Assassin Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the Twin Katanas (Addon 1) and the Ninja Shadow Mask (Addon 2).
entries.lore: Operatives of the silent guild strike from shadows unseen, armed with forged blades and concealed faces.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Who disturbs the shadows?"
Player: "outfit"
NPC: "Prove your lethal devotion with rare trophies of dragons and minotaur lords."
Player: "yes"

steps.title: Assassin Addon 1 (Twin Katanas)
steps.instruction: Find the Ghostly Woman in the assassin guild secret hideout near Venore.

entries.name: Warrior Outfit & Addons
entries.description: Unlocks the Greatsword on Back (Addon 1) and Spiked Battle Helm (Addon 2).
entries.lore: A heavy two-handed greatsword slung across the back, ready to cleave through waves of enemies.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, traveler."
Player: "addon"
NPC: "Seeking the warrior blade? Bring royal steel and dragon claws."
Player: "yes"

steps.title: Warrior Addon 1 (Back Sword)
steps.instruction: Speak with Trisha at the Carlin warrior barracks.

entries.name: Widow Queen (Giant Spider)
entries.description: Tame the lethal giant arachnid using Sweet Smelling Bait.
entries.lore: The Widow Queen rules the deepest subterranean webs. Only the scent of sweet pheromone bait can calm her deadly aggression.
entries.dialogTranscript:
1. Obtain Sweet Smelling Bait (drop from Wailing Widow or Market).
2. Locate a Wailing Widow in Krailos or deep Ghostlands.
3. Right-click the bait and use it on the creature to tame it.

steps.title: Find and Tame the Widow Queen
steps.instruction: Use the Sweet Smelling Bait on a wild Wailing Widow until successfully tamed.

entries.name: Crystal Wolf
entries.description: Extinguish the blaze in Shadowthorn and tune your Diapason to tame the Crystal Wolf.
entries.lore: When the thorn fortress burns, mystical crystal wolves emerge from the elemental nexus. The harmonic sound of a Diapason bonds them to their rider.
entries.dialogTranscript:
1. Travel to Shadowthorn when the world event is active.
2. Extinguish elf fire pits with water buckets.
3. When the Crystal Wolf spawns, use the Diapason on it.

steps.title: Shadowthorn World Event
steps.instruction: Enter the elven fortress of Shadowthorn and extinguish fires to reveal the wolves.

entries.name: Donkey
entries.description: The faithful long-eared companion. Tamed using a simple Carrot on a Stick.
entries.lore: Humble yet tireless, the donkey will carry you through mountains and plains without complaint.
entries.dialogTranscript:
1. Go to the farm mill in Thais or Venore.
2. Pull the grain levers until you or a creature is turned into a donkey.
3. Use the Carrot on a Stick to tame it.

steps.title: Tame with Carrot on a Stick
steps.instruction: Use the Carrot on a Stick on a Donkey at the farm.

entries.name: Stampor (Fossil Mammoth)
entries.description: Craft a prehistoric leather harness to ride the mighty armored Stampor.
entries.lore: Ancestral beasts unearthed from glacial permafrost, Stampors break through stone and ice with monumental strength.
entries.dialogTranscript:
1. Gather Stampor horns, feathers and leathers.
2. Craft the Harness at an ancient forge.
3. Track a Stampor in Svargrond caverns and use the Harness.

steps.title: Locate and Tame Stampor
steps.instruction: Descend into the underground ice tunnels to encounter wild Stampors.

entries.name: Ursagrodon (Glacial Bear)
entries.description: Melt the frozen glacier block with a Melting Horn to awaken and tame the Ursagrodon.
entries.lore: Ancient apex predators locked in glacial ice for thousands of years, awakened by the song of the melting horn.
entries.dialogTranscript:
1. Travel to the frozen realm of Chyllfroest.
2. Find the frozen ice monolith containing the dormant bear.
3. Use the Melting Horn on the ice block to liberate and tame it.

steps.title: Melt the Ursagrodon Ice Block
steps.instruction: Use the Melting Horn on the frozen block on the ice sheets.

entries.name: Goroma Volcano Access
entries.description: Unlock shipwreck travel to the volcanic island of Goroma and Ramoa.
entries.lore: Captain Jack Fate knows the uncharted reefs south of Liberty Bay. Purchasing an off-course passage causes your ship to shipwreck upon Goroma's fiery shores.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Ahoy! Looking for passage?"
Player: "passage"
NPC: "Do you want to sail towards the southern reef? It can be treacherous."
Player: "goroma"
NPC: "Set sail!"
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: Permanent Ferry Route to Goroma, Ramoa & Malor Volcano

steps.title: Speak with Captain Jack Fate
steps.instruction: Head to the Liberty Bay docks and ask Jack Fate for passage to Goroma.

entries.name: Meriana & Laguna Islands Access
entries.description: Complete Eleonore's missions to unlock boat voyages to the Tortoise islands of Meriana.
entries.lore: Lady Eleonore is worried about rumors in the archipelago. By assisting her in her investigation, she introduces you to Captain Raymond Striker.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings. Are you here to assist a lady in distress?"
Player: "mission"
NPC: "My precious ring was taken. Will you investigate?"
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: Boat Access to Meriana, Laguna Islands & Treasure Island

steps.title: Eleonore's Investigation
steps.instruction: Visit Eleonore in her manor in northern Liberty Bay to begin the quest chain.

entries.name: Yalahar Quarter Gates Access
entries.description: Unlock the massive security gates connecting all 8 districts of Yalahar.
entries.lore: The city of Yalahar was divided into isolated sectors following the great cataclysm. Inquisitor Palimuth seeks reliable adventurers to reopen travel through the gates.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Welcome to Yalahar. I am Palimuth."
Player: "mission"
NPC: "Will you help inspect the foreign and arena quarters?"
Player: "pass"
NPC: "Take this authorization pass for the city gates."
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: City Gate Passes & Teleport Hub Access

steps.title: Meet Palimuth at South Gate
steps.instruction: Speak with Palimuth standing near the grand southern gate of Yalahar.

entries.name: Feyrist Fairy Island Access
entries.description: Complete the Threatened Dreams quest to unlock the fairy portal in Thais.
entries.lore: The dream realm of Feyrist is endangered by nightmare corrupters. Rebalancing the fairy shrines bridges the mortal realm to this magical island.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "The forest whispers of danger..."
Player: "mission"
NPC: "The dream shrines have been corrupted. Will you help cleanse them?"
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: Feyrist Fairy Shrines, Sun Catcher & Portal to Feyrist

steps.title: Speak with Maelyrra
steps.instruction: Find the fairy guardian Maelyrra north of Ab'Dendriel in the sacred grove.

entries.name: The Postman Missions Quest
entries.description: Earn substantial discounts on all boat & carpet travel, and use locked royal postboxes.
entries.lore: The Royal Tibian Postal Service has connected the kingdom for centuries. Rising through the ranks from Assistant to Grand Postman grants immense travel privileges.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, traveler! Welcome to the Post Office."
Player: "mission"
NPC: "Do you want to join our noble courier guild and run your first delivery?"
Player: "yes"
NPC: "First, swear your postman oath and deliver this priority parcel to Kroox!"

rewards.name: 10 GP Discount on ALL Boat & Carpet travels
Access to Locked Royal Postboxes across the world

steps.title: Mission 1: The Postman Oath & Kroox Parcel
steps.instruction: Visit Headmaster Kevin at the Royal Postal Office along the road between Thais and Kazordoon.

steps.title: Mission 2: Kroox's Package in Kazordoon
steps.instruction: Deliver the heavy package to blacksmith Kroox near the entrance to Kazordoon.

steps.title: Mission 3: Secret Letter to King Markwin in Mintwallin
steps.instruction: Descend deep beneath Thais into the ancient minotaur capital to deliver the diplomatic letter.

entries.name: The Inquisition Quest
entries.description: Purge the 7 Infernal Seals, unlock shortcut teleports, and earn top tier holy armor.
entries.lore: High Inquisitor Henricus leads the sacred order against the underworld cults. Cleansing the 7 Seals allows permanent fast-travel shortcuts through the demonic underworld.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, son of the light. Do you seek the Inquisition?"
Player: "inquisition"
NPC: "Are you willing to swear the solemn oath to eradicate darkness wherever it hides?"
Player: "mission"
NPC: "Take the holy water and cleanse the shadow altars."
Player: "yes"

steps.title: The Solemn Oath of the Inquisition
steps.instruction: Speak with High Inquisitor Henricus inside the Thais royal courtyard.

entries.name: Pits of Inferno (PoI)
entries.description: The legendary Nightmare Knights descent to the 7 Thrones. Rewards: Soft Boots & Arcane Shield.
entries.lore: Deep under the Plains of Havoc lies the necromantic bastion constructed to contain the Ruthless Seven. Breaching the seals and touching the seven thrones rewards unmatched relics.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Greetings, mortal! I am Avar Tar, conqueror of perils."
Player: "pits of inferno"
NPC: "Only the bravest warriors survive the descent past the dragon lords and demon thrones."
Player: "yes"

rewards.name: Pair of Soft Boots (Regenerates 12 HP & 12 MP/tick)

steps.title: The Plains of Havoc Entrance
steps.instruction: Enter the cathedral crypts in PoH and remove the stone barrier with holy water.

entries.name: The Queen of the Banshees
entries.description: Break the 7 mystical seals in Ghostlands to face the Queen. Rewards: Boots of Haste & Stealth Ring.
entries.lore: The crypts beneath Ghostlands harbor the sorrowful Banshee Queen. Solving her 7 trials of logic, sacrifice and true path grants the prized Boots of Haste.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Who dares summon the Queen of Sorrows?"
Player: "seal"
NPC: "Break the ancient seal and claim your fate."
Player: "yes"

steps.title: Trial 1: The Hidden Seal
steps.instruction: Descend into the ghost crypts and unlock the first elemental seal.

entries.name: The Annihilator Quest
entries.description: The pinnacle 4-player team challenge against 6 Demons. Reward: Demon Armor, SoV or SCA.
entries.lore: Four level 100+ heroes stand on four tiles, pulling the lever to be teleported into a narrow chamber surrounded by 6 enraged Demons.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Assemble your 4-player team:
- Stand in position on the four stone tiles.
- Pull the golden lever when all party members are ready.

rewards.name: Magic Sword (Sword of Valor - Atk: 48, Def: 35)

steps.title: The Chamber of Six Demons
steps.instruction: Descend to floor -7 of the Hero Cave in Edron and pull the lever with your squad.

entries.name: The Djinn War (Green vs Blue)
entries.description: Choose your allegiance: Marid (Blue - Haroun) or Efreet (Green - Yaman) to trade rare treasures.
entries.lore: An eternal feud between the noble Marid djinn and the ferocious Efreet djinn in the Ankrahmun peaks. Aligning with one grants entry to their fortress market.
entries.dialogTranscript:
Player: "hi"
NPC: "Alms for a blind beggar?"
Player: "djinn"
NPC: "The djinn fortress requires the ancient greeting word. Give me 1 coin for the secret."
Player: "word"
NPC: "The word is DJANNI'HAH. Remember it!"

rewards.name: Trade access to Djinn rare equipment shops

steps.title: Learn the Sacred Djinn Greeting
steps.instruction: Speak with the blind beggar Melchior in Ankrahmun to learn the secret pass phrase.
